checks: Present perfect continuing work plus the year as a starting point calls for ‘since’. ‘For’ takes a duration, ‘until’ marks an endpoint, and ‘during’ a bounded period rather than a start continuing to the present. Chinese accurately preserves ongoing supplier-quality work and year; all options and rationales checked.

activeQuestion.prompt: Ms. Chen has worked in supplier quality ____ 2019.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 陳女士____ 2019 年便一直從事供應商品質管理工作。

options.whyZh: for 後接一段時間，例如 for seven years，不直接用此處的年份作期間。
until 2019 指結束點，與 has worked 所表達的持續起點不符。
during 2019 只指那一年期間，無法表達持續至今的起點。
2019 是起始時間點，完成式搭配 since 表示持續至今。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 2019 是起始時間點，完成式搭配 since 表示持續至今。

vocabulary.note: 對供應材料或供應商製程品質的管理。
